independentEvidenceAdjustments: The direct Harrison Street Business Wire release verifies only that Harrison Street stated on 2021-12-21 that it then owned the Fort Detrick district-energy system. It is not a cutoff-current member or beneficial-owner schedule.

The direct Simpson Thacher notice verifies that BlackRock GEPIF sold an interest in the Fort Detrick Energy Production Facility, but it does not identify the legal buyer or seller entities, transferred percentage, retained interests, signed documents, effective date, or legal closing date.

The IPE report identifies Harrison Street SIF and BlackRock GEPIF at fund level and reports an acquisition for an undisclosed sum, but it is a trade source and cannot substitute for executed ownership documents.

The PowerSurety participant page supports the Fort Detrick/KFDE asset and SPV boundary and distinguishes developer, contractor, host and owner roles. Its historical First Reserve label does not prove the 2026 cap table.

The direct BlackRock release verifies acquisition of First Reserve's two-fund energy-infrastructure franchise in 2017, not the asset-level title chain. The K&L Gates record and First Reserve portfolio page corroborate earlier sellers and realized status without resolving dates, stakes, vehicles, or the current member chain.

The model-recommended Business Wire source is usable as the sole research primary for the latest located direct asset-specific ownership statement, but it supports only a terminal DEFERRED exception and no company or owner creation.
